clue.text: Soldier with overturned reputation left to pine

indicators.note: overturned says the whole string built from the following pieces is turned upside down, read back to front in this down-free across entry

parts.note: a reputation is one's good name
a fir is a kind of pine tree

explanation.surface: A soldier whose good name has been ruined is left to languish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overturned' turns the whole run NAME + L + FIR, giving the answer; 'pine' looks like a verb (to languish) but is the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifleman is an infantry soldier armed with a rifle, a private in a rifle regiment.

clue.text: I was in charge of the country

parts.note: to run something is to be in charge of it, and ran is the past tense

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of having been in charge of the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Iran is a nation in western Asia.

clue.text: Rising leaders of municipal departments rather oddly entertained by regal magistrate

indicators.note: rising, in a down clue, means the whole construction reads from bottom to top
entertained by means the initials are held inside the word for regal

parts.note: regal means royal

indicators.note: leaders of means the first letters of the four words that follow

explanation.surface: Heads of city departments are oddly hosted by a royal official.
explanation.walkthrough: The initials M D R O sit inside ROYAL, and 'Rising' turns the whole ROYAMDROL upward; 'rather oddly' looks like an alternate-letters instruction but is just two more initials.
explanation.definitionFit: A lord mayor is the chief civic officer of a major city, historically with magisterial powers.

clue.text: Historical city housing one maiden written up in historical account

indicators.note: written up, in a down clue, means the letters are entered from the bottom upwards
housing means the city's name contains the numeral one

parts.note: Rome is the ancient city
I is the Roman numeral for one
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: An ancient city accommodating one maiden, as recorded in a chronicle.
explanation.walkthrough: ROME around I gives ROIME, plus M makes RIOMEM, which 'written up' turns upward. A maiden is an over with no runs scored in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: A memoir is a written account of events from personal knowledge, an autobiographical record.

clue.text: Miss no component out making crackers

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of order, rearranged into a new phrase

explanation.surface: Leave out no part when making Christmas crackers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crackers' looks like the party novelty but means mad; 'out' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin legal phrase means not of sound mind, i.e. insane.

clue.text: Shanty in naval battle lacking piano accompaniment

indicators.note: lacking says something is missing from the battle's name, so a letter is taken out

parts.note: Lepanto was the great naval battle of 1571 between the Holy League and the Ottoman fleet
p (piano, softly) is the musical marking, here dressed up as the accompaniment that goes missing

explanation.surface: A sea shanty sung at a naval battle without a piano to accompany it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shanty' suggests a sea song alongside 'naval battle', but it is a rough hut. Remove P from LEPANTO.
explanation.definitionFit: A shanty is a crude shack, and a lean-to is a simple shelter propped against a wall.

clue.text: Means to escape pressure, on short holiday in SW resort

indicators.note: in places the pressure and holiday pieces inside the name of the resort

parts.note: Looe is a seaside town in Cornwall, in south-west England
P is the physics symbol for pressure
hol is a clipped form of holiday

explanation.surface: A break from pressure on a quick trip to a south-western seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: Looe is a Cornish fishing port and holiday town; 'in' sets the pressure and holiday pieces inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A loophole is a gap in rules that allows evasion, a way out.

clue.text: Tree in ski resort

definitions.meaning: a fashionable winter sports town in Colorado

explanation.surface: A tree standing in a ski resort.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspen is both a poplar species and a Colorado resort town.

clue.text: Lady turns up in resort, avoiding unknown inquisitor

indicators.note: in places the reversed lady inside the shortened resort name
avoiding means the resort name does without the unknown letter

parts.note: Torquay is a seaside resort in Devon
Y is one of the algebraic unknowns

indicators.note: turns up, in a down clue, means the word for a lady is read upwards

parts.note: a dame is a titled lady

explanation.surface: A lady shows up at a seaside resort, dodging an unknown interrogator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'avoiding' drops Y from the Devon resort; 'turns up' reverses the lady to EMAD, which 'in' places inside. Torquemada led the Spanish Inquisition.
explanation.definitionFit: Tomás de Torquemada was the notorious first Grand Inquisitor of the Spanish Inquisition.

clue.text: Love coming after marriage, perhaps — that's capital

indicators.note: coming after places the love letter behind the word for marriage in the answer

parts.note: marriage is one example of a sacrament in church teaching
love is zero in tennis, written as the letter O

explanation.surface: Love that follows a wedding is something worth having.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like slang for excellent, but it is a state capital: Sacramento is the capital of California.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacramento is the seat of government of the US state of California.

clue.text: Character beginning to paint pictures

indicators.note: beginning to means only the opening letter of the next word is used

parts.note: pictures in general are art

explanation.surface: A personality type who is just starting out painting pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: A character in a play is a role that an actor takes on.

clue.text: Cake plays a prominent part at US wedding

definitions.meaning: a small tart with a curd or almond filling, traditionally associated with Richmond

definitions.text: a prominent part at US wedding
definitions.meaning: the chief bridesmaid at an American wedding, an unmarried woman attending the bride

explanation.surface: A wedding cake takes centre stage at an American ceremony.
explanation.walkthrough: The cake is a small British tart of puff pastry and curd; the American term is for the chief bridesmaid.
explanation.definitionFit: The same name covers a curd tart from Richmond and the leading bridesmaid at an American wedding.

clue.text: Rebuilding, I model it on ruin

indicators.note: rebuilding means the letters of the following words are rebuilt into a new shape

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Reconstructing something by basing my model on a ruin.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter's 'Rebuilding' covers all of I MODEL IT ON, but only MODEL truly needs rearranging (to DEMOL); IT, I and ON then follow as they stand.
explanation.definitionFit: Demolition is the wrecking or destruction of a building, its ruin.

clue.text: Real heroism has no need of support

indicators.note: has no need of means the supporting garment is dropped from the word for heroism

parts.note: heroism is bravery
a bra is a supporting undergarment

explanation.surface: True courage does not need anyone to prop it up.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing BRA from BRAVERY leaves the adjective; 'Real' as in 'the very thing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Very as an adjective means actual or precise, as in 'the very man I wanted'.

clue.text: College has high, excessively high number of matches

parts.note: poly is short for polytechnic, a type of college
gamy describes meat that is high, that has been hung until strongly flavoured, here excessively so

explanation.surface: A college where the students get high, and then too high.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high' looks like drugs or altitude, but it describes game meat hung too long; 'matches' are marriages, not games.
explanation.definitionFit: Polygamy is having several spouses at once, so many marital unions.

clue.text: Bridge team sweeps the board

parts.note: a gang is a team of workers
a plank is a long board

explanation.surface: A bridge-playing team wins every trick at the table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bridge' looks like the card game, given 'sweeps the board', but it is the walkway onto a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A gangplank is a movable walkway bridging a ship and the quay.

clue.text: Keep quiet and finish off properly

definitions.meaning: to stay silent, keep one's mouth shut
to complete a task neatly, tie up loose ends

explanation.surface: Stop talking and complete the job.
explanation.definitionFit: Button up means both shut up and wrap a job up successfully.

clue.text: Aboard ship, our pence get us a crab

indicators.note: aboard puts the following pieces on board, that is inside the abbreviation for a steamship

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: On board, our small change buys us a crab to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crab' is not the shellfish but a bad-tempered person.
explanation.definitionFit: A crab, figuratively, is a grumpy person, the same as a sullen killjoy.

clue.text: One's barely visible

parts.note: read 'barely' as 'in the bare', so someone with no clothes on is on show, rather than scarcely seen

explanation.definitionFit: Someone unclothed is visible in a bare state, which is the pun on barely.

clue.text: Pitman carrying about a chopper

indicators.note: carrying means the miner holds the abbreviation for about inside

parts.note: a pitman works down a pit, a coal miner
c, for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A coal miner carrying an axe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chopper' suggests an axe in a miner's hands but is a meat grinder.
explanation.definitionFit: A mincer chops meat finely, so it is a chopping machine.

clue.text: Elusive person lies low, with unorthodox character leading pursuit

indicators.note: unorthodox means the letters of lies low with are arranged in an unconventional order
character leading means the first letter of the word pursuit is taken

explanation.surface: A fugitive lies low, with an odd type heading the chase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unorthodox' signals rearranging LIESLOWWITH; 'character leading pursuit' gives P, tacked on at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A will-o'-the-wisp is a ghostly marsh light, hence anyone or anything impossible to catch.

clue.text: Shrub I call something else

indicators.note: something else means the letters of the words are turned into another word altogether

explanation.surface: I give this bush a different name.
explanation.definitionFit: Lilac is a flowering bush with fragrant purple or white blooms.

clue.text: Part of 15's design

indicators.note: part of means the answer is a stretch found within the answer to 15 down

explanation.surface: A section of the bridge's blueprint.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer to 15 down is GANGPLANK; its middle letters hold the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan is a design or scheme drawn up in advance.

clue.text: Work on check-out

definitions.meaning: to cultivate land, to work the soil
the cash register at a shop counter

explanation.surface: Working on the supermarket checkout.
explanation.definitionFit: To till is to plough or cultivate, and a till is a cash register.

clue.text: Conspicuous and unrestrained celebration after king's deposal

indicators.note: unrestrained means the remaining letters are let loose into a new arrangement
deposal means the king is removed, so his letter is taken out of the word celebration

parts.note: R, for rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A wild and obvious party after the monarch is overthrown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deposal' removes R from CELEBRATION, giving CELEBATION; 'unrestrained' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Something conspicuous is easily seen or striking.

clue.text: Mushroom home crowd rejected

parts.note: being in means being at home

indicators.note: rejected means the word for a crowd is turned back on itself

parts.note: a pack is a crowd of people

explanation.surface: A crowd at home rejects a mushroom dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns the crowd backwards, giving KCAP, placed after the word for being at home.
explanation.definitionFit: An ink cap is a mushroom whose cap dissolves into a black inky liquid.

clue.text: Out for 24

definitions.meaning: out on strike, taking industrial action
the answer to 24 across, meaning conspicuous or eye-catching

explanation.surface: Out for twenty-four.
explanation.definitionFit: Workers who walk out are on strike, and a striking sight is a noticeable one.
